method.novelty: For each proposal, its ANCHOR conditioning variable was computed exactly as its packet defines it (fields, clock bounds, as-of rule avail<gate(t), fiscal-match rules where declared) on the frozen 30 quarterly decision dates over its declared universe (A4/A5: ALIVE+DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED with the packet's eligibility floor - 63 bars, ADV63 band C+, RAW>=1.00 - and anchor populated; A5 pre-selection diagnostics additionally on the packet's declared 63-bar-only pre-check universe; A6: DEAD leg only). Pooled Spearman (midrank ties) vs reimplemented forbidden-ancestor variables computed per research/assets/stocks/v8_family_runner.py specs: SFV8-F1 accrual FLOW (AR/INV/AP YoY legs, per-field 330-400d eff match, Assets<=400d, t-252-session reference), WC stock-LEVEL shadow (AR+INV-AP)/Assets, SFV8-F2 coverage AccumDep/PPEGross (<=400d, eff-agreement<=400d), Goodwill/Assets shadow, V4-style 21d/252d dollar-volume participation ratio, 63-session prior return (adjusted series). Gate: plan sec.1 |rho|<=0.20 vs F1/F2 forms and shadows and vs participation (forbidden ancestor claimed by A4-H1/A5-H1/A5-H2); 63-session return gated only where a packet claims a bar (A4-H1 <0.80).
method.A6_degenerate_pooling_note: A6 anchors (N63/P63) are date-level regime conditioners with zero within-date cross-sectional variance; the pooled (date,name) Spearman therefore resolves mathematically to the between-date component: Spearman of the 30 conditioner values vs the ancestor's cross-sectional mean over the dead-leg band-eligible set at each date (n=30). This is the honest carrying-through of the pooled standard, applied without loosening; flagged as an adjudication note for A1 (if the owner adjudicates the date-level application out of scope for the pooled standard, A6 eligibility flips).
method.fidelity: A6 active-series filter reimplemented from the packet's definition reproduced 1,250 active-series deaths vs the packet's 1,246 (forms 778 G/471 B/1 G-A vs 776/470); regime paths structurally reproduce (H1 mine 12/20/22 scored per fold vs packet 11/18/27; H2 mine 10/23/27 vs packet 11/26/27; fold-3 all-long L27/M0/H0 reproduces exactly). Tercile-rule implementation details (expanding-history quantiles) are the residual source of count differences.

ANCESTRY_SWEEP.verdict: PASS (no proposal's MECHANISM collapses to a listed forbidden mechanism under renaming/universe-change; where an exposure-form overlap exists it is caught and recorded by the measured item-1 gate, not by this sweep)

per_proposal_reasoning.a4_distress_H1: Mechanism: Merton/Campbell-Hilscher out-of-the-money-ness (liabilities vs price-transmitted market equity). Not a renaming of F1 (no WC accrual-delta construct, no AR/INV/AP fields) or F2 (no depreciation/conservatism construct). The sweep finds no universe-change or renaming route from this anchor to a listed mechanism. The failure is the measured-decorrelation gate (Goodwill/Assets shadow -0.221; F1 flow -0.20010): economically natural, since goodwill-heavy bloat and high book leverage co-move cross-sectionally, so the EXPOSURE forms overlap even though the mechanisms differ. Blocked by measurement per plan sec.1, not by mechanism identity.
per_proposal_reasoning.a4_distress_H2: Mechanism: retained-earnings depletion trajectory interacting with thin cash (Shumway profitability/Ohlson-Altman form). Shares the YoY-delta-over-Assets SHAPE with F1 but the accounting construct (RE vs WC components) and the cash interaction are disjoint; measured decorrelation holds (worst |rho| 0.163). No renaming collapses it to F1/F2 or any listed family. Sweep-clean; measured-clean.
per_proposal_reasoning.a5_clock_H1: Mechanism: filed claim-shape (audited book vs filed public float). Distinct construct from WC accrual, dep-coverage, participation, momentum, calendar. No collapse under renaming. Fails only the measured Goodwill/Assets shadow gate by 0.0028 - a shadow-level exposure overlap (bloat co-moves with float-marked-below-book), caught by the gate.
per_proposal_reasoning.a5_clock_H2: Mechanism: trade-credit chain position AP/AR. This is the wave's closest approach to a rescue-by-renaming: it shares BOTH working-capital legs with the forbidden WC stock-level shadow, and its declared functional-form rationale (ratio-of-legs vs signed asset-scaled sum reorders names) is empirically refuted - |rho|=0.41332 vs (AR+INV-AP)/Assets on 30/30 dates. Under renaming (AP/AR is a within-WC reparameterization of the same stock exposure) plus universe change (dead leg added), this is materially the WC stock exposure form on a new universe. Blocked both by this sweep's judgment and by its own declared A1 diagnostic.
per_proposal_reasoning.a6_death_H1: Mechanism: death-arrival intensity regime. The information set (evidenced Form-15 stream) did not exist in any prior cycle (V8 cohort 0/409 deaths); no renaming of a listed family produces an event-count regime conditioner. Sweep-clean at mechanism level. The measured item-1 failure is a timing-co-movement between the regime and forbidden-variable LEVELS in the dying cohort, not a mechanism collapse; under the plan's blanket measured gate it is nonetheless blocked (subject to the A6_degenerate_pooling_note adjudication).
per_proposal_reasoning.a6_death_H2: Mechanism: 12B/12G channel taxonomy - same new-information-set status as H1; sweep-clean at mechanism level; blocked by the measured date-level gate (|rho| 0.335-0.721 vs all four V8 forms) with the same adjudication note, plus the fold-3 all-long one-sidedness flag.
